clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, Athridas Bearmantle works to protect the settlement and its wilds. The night elf druid sends young adventurers to investigate corruption among local wildlife and the nearby Gnarlpine furbolgs.

In Dolanaar, Athridas Bearmantle helps defend night elves arriving from Shadowglen. Teldrassil, the newly grown world tree, shows unnatural signs of decay and unrest. Athridas organizes local scouting and guards the township against threats from the surrounding wilds.

Athridas worries over the nearby Gnarlpine furbolgs. Once peaceful neighbors, the tribe has fallen to spreading madness and corruption that poisons its shamans and chieftains, driving them to violence against the Kaldorei. Athridas calls on willing champions to contain the danger and investigate the deeper taint taking root in the wilderness.
